tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub kyi bca' gshom 'don 'grigs zin bris bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ swasti/

bca' bsham rnams gzhung gsal ltar la ston pa'i sku dar dmar ser gang rung gi na bza' can bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du g.yon nas brtsam ste chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga phreng tshar du bsham/ lte bar khri stegs khar yon bdag gi 'dra glud kyi lto bar e/ raṃ/ yaṃ/ khaṃ bzhi po dbu can bris pa dang*/ zho sha /dung*/ bse/ mtshal/ zer mo/ mu tig /lung thang*/ 'gron bu/ dar dmar/ dbang lag /lcags zangs tshal bu rnams glud 'phyong nang ltar gnas so sor bcug /shing byang rgyab tu 'dod gsol skabs thob gang dgos ltar so sor kha bsgyur la bri/ bdud bzhi'i rgyab tu rang mdog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar bzhi 'dzug /sher snying gzungs dang rten snying gzungs gzhug can gyi sātstsha bcu tshar/ dri bzang gis mdog bsgyur pa'i rab gnas 'thor nas bcas nye char bkod/ gzhan rnams gzhung bstan ltar las bsnan 'phri med/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar/ smra bsam brjod med sogs dang*/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa sogs nas/ mngon par bstod do/ bar tshar gcig mthar/ chos spyod las 'byung ba ltar skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi yan grub nas gzhung gi / oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs lhug / sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rdor dril bcas bsdu rgya/ thal sbyar bcas/ mgon po thugs rje sogs yo gdangs dang lhug gnyis gang bde/ pad med rang rgya bcas arghaṃ sogs shabda ra rol sil/ rang rgya bcas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sogs nas/ bskor bar gyur/ bar/ bzlas pa 1000 rang gi thugs ka'i sogs/ rdor gsor dang bzhi dril bcas chos spyod ltar/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ bar yo gdangs dang lhug gnyis gang bde/ mjug rol sil/ pad med rang rgyas arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ yo ga bzhi dril bcas/ bstod par 'os pa sogs mthar/ nam mkha'i lha sogs nas/ thim par gyur/ bar/ rten snying nyer gcig bzlas mthar nas brlabs/ thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs nas/

yang dag pa rnams so/ bar/ de nas zhwa bcas ye dhar dang dril gsil sngon 'gros rang gdangs sam lhug gnyis gang bde bzhi dril bcas phun sum tshogs pa sogs lhu gsum/ mjug rol sil/ zhwa phud/ pad med rang rgya bcas/ arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ bzhi dril dang yo gdangs bcas/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ dril bzhag /lhug gis ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ chen por bsngo/ bar/ sngags drug skabs pad med rang rgya bcas so so'i sngags tshar gsum re dang gyur ces dus rgya bkrol te se gol re/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs lhug 'don/ skabs 'dir gser skyems 'don na rang gdangs rol bcas 'don/ rjes zil mjug dang*/ gser skyems mi 'don na/ thang gsum zil mthar/ sbram sbram thang 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 thang sbram thang sbram thang zad nas rtse phran gyis bdud mgon bstod dbyangs ltar/ kye/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i mchog ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ sbram 1 2 sogs yang skyar rol gdangs gong ltar gyis bka' la nyon/ bar/ de nas dbyangs rol rjes zlog rol chung bas/ kye/ srid gsum 'di na sogs nas/ phyag sor bzhi yi rtse la bzhugs/ bar/ sbram sogs zlog rol chung ba dang zil 'beb 'og sngags/ mthar zlog rol chung bas/ kye/ sngon tshe rgyal ba sogs nas/ sri zhu'i mgron dang ldan gyur cig / sbram sbram 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 sbram sbram gyis bzhag /de nas kha 'bar ma'i sngags/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ gis bsngo zhing*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ sa phrin las gsol/ gter chen zin bris la de ltar mi 'byung yang zhal khrid las 'byung ba ltar bkod pa lags/ gong du gser skyems ma grub na 'dir gtang*/

de nas mgo rol med pas/ kye/ mtho ba rnams ni sogs nas/ rlung lha'i dmag tshogs zlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra sogs/ ye swā hā/ sbram sogs zlog chung gis bzhag /zil med/ skabs so sor gzhung gsal ltar skyems 'bul zhing*/ nas nag gis brab/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs mthar/ nam mkha' mdzod sngags rang rgya bcas lan gsum/ mgo rol med pas/ hūm̐/ srid gsum 'di na sogs nas/ skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs/ bar gtang*/ zlog chung gis bzhag /zil med/ thal sbyar me tog bcas/ na mo/ brgya bzhi'i sogs sman gdangs/ mthar me tog 'thor/ mgo rol med pas/ kye/ mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i sogs nas/ chag che nyam nga brgya bzhis zlog / bar rol zlog chung gis/ gong gi kye/ mtho ba rnams ni sogs nas 'di yan grangs bsags/ tshar rjes ma'i zlog par gzhung gsal ltar thal rdeb bya/ de min grangs gsag tshe thal rdeb med/ skabs 'dir grangs rdzogs nye ba'am yang na tshogs grol tshe mchod g.yog pas mthong brgyud bzhin nang nas sgo'i bar rim par/ dang po glud gtor rnams snod gcig /phung bdud ser po dang sātstsha snod gcig /'chi bdud nag po dang lan chags snod gcig /nyon bdud dmar po dang mar me snod gcig /lha bdud dkar po dang zhal zas snod gcig /de dag gi mdun gser skyems bcas bsham/ tshar rjes ma'i zlog rol chung bas sam/ tshogs grol ba yin na thang gsum zil dang zlog chung gis/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang sogs nas/ dam tshig las ni ma 'da' zhig / bar/ zlog chung mthar zil bzhag /de nas rang rol dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og na// gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' la nyon// dmar chen drag po'i gtor zor 'di// lha srin tshogs la 'phen snyam ste// dkar po'i phyogs la mi 'phen no// khyed rnams rang rang gnas la gshegs// hūm̐/

rnal 'byor zor 'phen gang du 'phen// sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su 'phen// phyogs der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams// sku gzur dbu smod zhabs sdus la// do nub zor gyi zor lam phye// 'khor bcas drag po'i dmag sna drongs// sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su khyer// dpa' ba'i 'phrul 'khor der shoms shig / ces gser skyems gtang*/ yas glud rnams nad pa sogs pho la g.yas dang mo la g.yon du bskor ba dang bcas/ zlog rol chung bas/ hūm̐/ bgegs kyi rgyal po sogs nas/ skye mched rigs bzhi'i gnas su dengs/ bar/ zlog chung mthar sbrel te drag rdung gis/ gang zhig mtshan mo sogs/ 'di'i dus lha bdud dang zhal zas shar/ nyon bdud dang mar me nub/ 'chi bdud dang lan chags lho/ phung bdud dang sātstsha byang du 'phen/ glud gtor yas lam/ dur khrod/ 'dre lnga/ bdud gcod sogs gang gnod du phul/ mjug drag rdung zil 'beb dang che mchog padma rgyag ste zil bzhag /de nas gzhung gsal shes rab snying po'i gzungs sngags brgya skor 'don mthar/ thang 1 sbram sbram byas 1 2 sogs drag rdung gis mtshams gcod gang 'os 'don/ mjug drag rdung mthar zil nas bzhag /sātstsha bcur re re bzhin/ rten snying 21 tsam bzlas te/ 'dir ni gzugs sogs sngags bcas kyis brtan bzhugs byas te/ gdangs lhug gang bdes/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ mthar rol sil/ khang pa'i phyogs mtshams rnams su gzhung gsal ltar 'jog /bar 'dir 'ga' zhig gis bdud bzhi'i gzugs rgyab kyi mda' dar bzhi po thogs te tshe 'gugs bya srol snang ba ltar byas kyang legs la ma byas kyang gzhung don chad skyon du 'gro ba ni ma yin pas 'dir mdzad srol med ces gsungs/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos te pad gcig rang rgya se gol bcas arghaṃ sogs rol sil/ rdo dril bcas yang dag rtsa gdangs kyis/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum sogs bzhi dril/

mjug rol sil bcas kyis grub/ phyag gis rdul tshon bsdus te khang steng lta bu gtsang sar gshegs te las rjes bsdu'o// de ltar brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub kyi 'don zin 'di ni rnam 'dren rdor 'dzin rnam grol rgya mtsho dang tshogs chen byang 'dren pa 'jam dpal tshul khrims zung gis zhal khrid ji ltar bstsal pa rnams rang gi dran gsos su btab pa ste 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes so/// /bdag bskyed kyi cho ga gzhan dang sbrel nas gtang tshul ni/ gter chen nyid kyi zin bris ltar shes par bya'o// ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
